description: Find out who wins EU public contracts in a market: competitors, partners or sales leads. Searches TED contract award notices by keywords, CPV, buyer countries, winner name and look-back days: winner, winner country, national ID, SME flag, awarded value and currency, decision date, buyer, CPV and links. Use when sizing a public-sector market or researching a competitor's contracts. $0.03 per call, USDC on Base (x402).
